events.title: Joseph Smith Killed by a Mob in Carthage, Illinois
events.description: Joseph Smith, founder of the Latter Day Saint movement, and his brother Hyrum were shot to death when an armed mob stormed the Carthage Jail, where they were being held on charges of treason and riot.
events.significance: The killing set off a succession crisis that split the movement. The largest group followed Brigham Young west to Utah, which shaped the settlement of the American West.

events.title: Battle of Gaines' Mill
events.description: Confederate General Robert E. Lee attacked the Union V Corps near Richmond, Virginia. It was the third of the Seven Days Battles, and Lee's forces broke the Union line late in the day.
events.significance: Lee's victory pushed the Union army back from Richmond and ended the Peninsula Campaign. It also established his reputation as a bold commander.

events.title: Birth of Helen Keller
events.description: Helen Keller was born in Tuscumbia, Alabama. She lost her sight and hearing in infancy. With the help of her teacher Anne Sullivan, she learned to communicate and went on to become an author and lecturer.
events.significance: Keller became a worldwide advocate for people with disabilities and for social reform. Her birthday is marked as Helen Keller Day in the United States.

events.title: World's First Grid-Connected Nuclear Power Plant Begins Operation
events.description: The AM-1 reactor at Obninsk in the Soviet Union was connected to the electrical grid. It was the first nuclear power plant to supply electricity to a power network.
events.significance: Obninsk showed that atomic energy could be used for civilian power as well as weapons. It opened the way for nuclear power stations around the world.

events.title: Djibouti Gains Independence from France
events.description: Djibouti, formerly French Somaliland, became an independent nation after a referendum. It was the last French colony on the African mainland to gain independence.
events.significance: The strategically located Horn of Africa nation now hosts major international naval bases and a busy shipping port. Independence Day is celebrated there every June 27.
